events.title: Expendabots Demo Is Live! Next Stop: Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Expendabots demo is out now, and we’re bringing it to Steam Next Fest! We’ve been busy fixing issues, adding a tutorial, and finding new ways for you to mess with your friends. And if you’re a streamer, your viewers can now join in on the fun. Your definition of “fun” may differ from theirs. Watch our new Expendabots Steam Next Fest Demo trailer🎓 Tutorial: Your first day on the jobNew to Expendabots? We’ve added a tutorial to help you learn the ropes before heading into the ever-changing islands

events.title: Playtest Update: Dungeon Quotas & Emotes!

events.title: The Heartbeat update is out now 🫀
events.summary: The Heartbeat Update is here!Over the past month, we have been actively playtesting Expendabots and collecting your feedback on our Discord and directly in the game. Your reports, ideas, and reactions helped shape this update. Thanks to your input, we are excited to bring it to you today.IMPROVED UI We have overhauled almost the entire user interface and added many new indicators. events.title: Watch Devs Play
events.summary: Expendabots is a 4-player cooperative horror extraction game where players control clunky but resourceful Expendabots scavenging procedurally generated islands.Expendabots was revealed on Future Games Show Summer Showcase.

events.title: Announcing Expendabots - Craft on the Fly, Extract, Repeat - No Refunds!
events.summary: Hey everyone! 🤖 We’re excited to finally announce Expendabots, our frantic new 4-player co-op horror extraction game - revealed today during the Future Games Show. Watch the Announcement TrailerThis has been a long time coming, and seeing Expendabots out in the world feels surreal. Our team at Collision Games, alongside our publishing friends at Blue Brain Games have been working behind the scenes for months on this reveal.
